notes: the opening «وَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is a bare saying (rule 10); the two chains that follow («رَوَى ذَلِكَ» and «وَ رَوَاهُ») carry the same ruling but end at the Imams Baqir and Sadiq, so whether Ali is the last link of those routes is not settled; the blessings are not part of the surfaces
